items.title: A $1 Million Dividend Portfolio Could Pay You $40,000 a Year. A Roth IRA Changes What You Keep
items.summary: Two retirees can collect identical dividends from identical stocks and still walk away with very different paychecks. The gap depends on which account holds the shares, and for payers like AGNC and Ares Capital it compounds into a surprisingly costly mistake.

items.title: Verizon Communications (VZ) Cuts 13,000 Jobs As Dan Schulman Pushes Turnaround
items.summary: Verizon Communications (NYSE:VZ) is undergoing a CEO-led overhaul under Dan Schulman, focused on stripping out entrenched bureaucracy. The turnaround plan includes approximately 13,000 job cuts as part of a broader restructuring of management layers and internal processes. Management is tying the cultural reset to early signs of improved customer performance and profitability across Verizon's core operations.
